theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) (f g : Eucl P → ℝ) (LW : ℝ≥0) (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (t h c δ : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) → Differentiable ℝ g → Differentiable ℝ χ → (∀ x ∈ tsupport ω, |g x - f x| ≤ δ) → (∀ x ∈ tsupport ω, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖₊ ≤ LW) → (∀ s, |deriv χ s| ≤ c) → (∀ s, s ∉ Ioo (t - h) t → deriv χ s = 0) → ∫⁻ x, (‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => χ (g y)) x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (tsupport ω ∩ f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - h - δ) (t + δ))
